"Out on a pleasure cruise, three friends enjoy the sunset on a calm sea. All three are full of youthful vigor and fertility, in their prime. And so they were noticed by the Deep Ones. Two males chose their brides and one hybrid female chose her mate. They waited patiently until the humans were intoxicated and drowsy, to make their copulation more enjoyable for all parties. It was a fruitful evening."
